title: Cables
intro: Which switch port goes to which patch panel port and seat. Each cable gets a label for both ends with a QR code that opens it here. Cables in NetBox come in with the import and stay NetBox's.
search: Search label, switch, port, panel or seat
empty: No cables yet. Add one, or import them from NetBox.
label: Label
panelPlaceholder: Empty when it goes straight to the seat
fromImport: This cable comes from {{plugin}}. Change it there and import again.
patchIntro: Say once which switch a block is patched to: Floorbit makes a cable for every seat. Planning the same block again moves its cables.
replace: Replace the cables in the way
checkMissing_one: {{count}} cable names a port the switch doesn't have
checkMissing_other: {{count}} cables name a port the switch doesn't have
checkUnplanned_one: {{count}} port is up and no cable says what is on it
checkUnplanned_other: {{count}} ports are up and no cable says what is on them
checkUnread: Not read (not on the floor plan, or offline): {{switches}}
clientsNone: Every machine is on a port the cables explain.
clientsMovedLine: {{port}} is cabled to {{seat}}, but {{ip}} is the IP of {{other}}
clientsUnplanned_one: {{count}} machine on a port no cable explains
clientsUnplanned_other: {{count}} machines on ports no cable explains
areasIntro: Which seats a batch of ports goes to, before each seat's port is known. Used to say where a port probably is, and to catch check-ins far from their seat.
areasEmpty: No port areas yet. A 40-port switch in batches of 10 is four lines.
areasHow: Ports in batches, and the first seat of each batch. The batch goes to as many seats from there as it has ports. Leave a batch empty for uplinks or access points. Saving replaces this switch's areas.
